rows.name: byte overlap destroys address upper zero

rows.body:
mov wr12,#0x007e
 mov wr14,#0xfd5b
 jz other
 mov wr14,#0xfd53
 sjmp join
other:
 mov wr14,#0xfd5f
join:
 mov dr16,dr12
 mov @dr16,r9
 eret
